import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0072 {α : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (s : Finset α) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
  Finset.image f s ⊆ Finset.image f (Finset.range f) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0072 {α : Type*} {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (s : Finset α) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
  Finset.image f s ⊆ Finset.image f (Finset.range f) :=
by
  intros x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  use Finset.mem_range_of_mem f s hx
  rw [Finset.mem_image]
  exact hf hx
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0072 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0072 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0072

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0072
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0072
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
